roles.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer – Shipment Tracking
roles.description: Kestrel's tracking team owns the live shipment view that dispatchers and end customers use around the clock. You build features end to end: a React and TypeScript front end with map visualisation, Node.js services that consume carrier telematics events from Kafka, and the PostgreSQL read models behind them. Typical work includes designing a new exception-handling flow for delayed loads, reducing the time-to-first-position for new shipments, and hardening the public tracking link against abuse. You pair with product design on interaction details, write the tests that keep releases boring, and take part in a one-week-in-six on-call rotation. We expect several years of production web development, comfort across the stack, and the judgement to keep a growing codebase understandable for the next engineer.
